WEATHER FORECAST FOR 08 AUGUST 2026
Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 08 August 2026.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Sabaragamuwa and Western provinces and in
Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Cloudy skies will prevail over these areas.
Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy
and Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Several spells of showers may occur in North-western province.
Strong winds of about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over North-central, Sabaragamuwa,
Southern, Central and North-western provinces.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 08 August 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Matara via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be westerly to south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph.
Wind speed can increase up to (60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Mannar via Kalpitiya and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Batticaloa to Mannar via Trincomalee and Kankasanthurai and from Chilaw to Matara via Colombo
and Galle.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Chilaw to Mannar via Kalpitiya and from Matara to
Pottuvil via Hambantota will be rough or very rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are
advised not to venture into these sea areas, until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Batticaloa to Mannar via Trincomalee and Kankasanthurai
and from Chilaw to Matara via Colombo and Galle will be rough at times. The naval and fishing
communities who are engaged in fishing and naval activities in the above sea areas are requested to
be vigilant in this regard.
The wave height may increase about (2.5 – 3.0) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.
